description: Ternary weights on the E1 stack: identical layout and training recipe to E1, but every projection inside the blocks is BitNet b1.58 BitLinear (absmean ternary weights, per-token 8-bit absmax activations, straight-through estimator). Embeddings, norms, GDN gate projections (a, b) and short convolutions stay full precision. One ingredient changed vs E1: weight precision.
